text:
sofia: Heads-up — we're seeing a regional ingress rate-window oscillation in eu-west1 causing intermittent 502/504s for some hosted customers. Impact: generation + embeddings routes, error rates up to ~7% on heavy routes.

ops-bot: Incident created INC-2026-0453 — triage channel: #incidents, severity: high.

raj: Quick summary from triage: sudden bursty fanout from free-tier + aggressive client retrying triggered our rate-window limiter. Autoscaler responded but the limiter's eviction thresholds amplified short-term throttling.

mike: Deployed smoothing fix (deploy/ingress-smoother@sha:abc123) at 2026-03-23T12:04:10Z -> rolled 50% -> 100% in eu-west1 by 12:06Z. Seeing error rate drop to ~1.2% across gen endpoints.

leah: Customer impact: ~120 accounts affected intermittently; support notified top 10 with mitigation steps. Status page update: https://status.redwood.ai/incidents/INC-2026-0453 :loud_sound:

sofia: Current status = mitigated & monitoring. Root cause: eviction thresholds too tight under high fanout; follow-ups: adjust defaults, add longer-term smoothing, improve per-customer burst detection. Owning postmortem: raj.

raj: Quick log snippet: `ingress-limiter.rate_window_evictions{region="eu-west1"} 3421` over 5m window. Also saw spiky client retry patterns from a small set of IP blocks.

mike: Added conservative per-tenant caps to dedicated pools as precaution. If you see any regression, ping @mike and I'll roll a hotfix.

product-ops: Do we want a customer-facing broadcast beyond the status page?

elaine: CS drafted a short note; waiting on final numbers from SRE. ETA ~30m to publish.

sofia: Action items: 1) continue monitoring for 1h, 2) schedule postmortem w/ SRE+Platform+Support, 3) push config change to housekeeping playbooks. If anyone needs runbooks, see: https://wiki.redwood.ai/playbooks/ingress-rate-window

ops-bot: Incident status changed => identified -> mitigated -> monitoring :white_check_mark:
